name: Issues in Educational Research

evidence.finding: The official ISSN-L cluster explicitly links print identifier 0313-7155 and online identifier 1837-6290 under this journal title.
The journal identifies 1837-6290 as online ISSN and explicitly says the previous 0313-7155 lapsed after print withdrawal at the end of 2007.

notes: Same journal across print/online formats. The print identifier is historical; the official journal says its print edition ended in 2007. Do not count the print and online entries as two journals.

name: Research & Practice in Technology Enhanced Learning

evidence.finding: The official ISSN-L cluster explicitly links print identifier 1793-2068 and online identifier 1793-7078 under this journal title.
The current APSCE journal site identifies the online ISSN as 1793-7078 and displays Vol. 21 (2026).

notes: The ISSN registry links the two media identifiers. Its old Singapore online record carries a 2006-2022 period, but the current APSCE site still uses online ISSN 1793-7078 and publishes a 2026 issue; do not infer current journal cessation from that legacy registry status.

name: Revista Linhas

evidence.finding: The official ISSN-L cluster explicitly links print identifier 1518-367X and online identifier 1984-7238 under this journal title.

evidence.locator: Identifiers; Publication; Available in another form
evidence.finding: The online record identifies UDESC as publisher, ISSN-L 1518-367X, and explicitly links the print version.
The official Revista Linhas site identifies UDESC postgraduate education as publisher and describes the journal as electronic.

notes: ISSN-L names the journal Linhas (Florianopolis), with print dates 2000-2005 and online dates from 2000. The publisher and online registry connect it to UDESC/Revista Linhas.

name: Science Education International

notes: The ISSN-L cluster and online record explicitly link the formats. Registry dates show print 1990-2008 and online from 2009. The separately cancelled ISSN 1022-6117 is not introduced into the catalog by this audit.

name: Australian Journal of English Education

evidence.finding: The official submission site explicitly identifies Australian Journal of English Education as previously titled English in Australia; the same page still carries legacy ISSN 0155-2147.

evidence.locator: PDF page 5 (printed page 3), Editorial; PDF page 88, imprint
evidence.finding: The 2023 volume 58 number 1 editorial says this is the first issue under the new title. The issue imprint identifies 2982-1215 as print ISSN and 2982-1223 as online ISSN.

notes: Consolidate the EBSCO current-title entry carrying legacy ISSN 0155-2147 into the existing JCR current-title record, preserving that baseline ID and metrics. Keep 0155-2147 explicitly historical and English in Australia as a former-title alias; do not relabel it as a third current medium identifier. Bibliographic title history and current journal identity should remain distinguishable.
